redfin.remarks: Welcome to 5389 Evergem Ave, a modern-style Palmdale home with a functional layout and inviting living spaces . This 4-bedroom, 2.5 bathroom residence offers 1,969 square feet, new LVP flooring , updated kitchen and bathrooms, and numerous windows that bring natural light throughout the home. The kitchen opens to the family room, while the living room offers a vaulted ceiling and fireplace. The floor plan includes an extra-large laundry room, a downstairs bedroom and half bath, and a primary bedroom with a vaulted ceiling. Set on a 6,833-square-foot lot at the end of a cul-de-sac, the property also features a 2-car garage and convenient access to shopping and restaurants.
